release.name: v0.1.0
release.headline: PTv3 multi-head trained on two LiDAR sweeps, so object velocity is now observable. Due to the tight schedule the T4 base corpus pretraining stage was skipped, so the model saw less training data than v0.0.1. The test definition changed alongside, trailers scored as trucks and a looser point filter, so the numbers are not comparable with v0.0.1.

model: Trained from scratch for 30 epochs on the j6gen2 corpus alone. The T4 base corpus pretraining stage v0.0.1 went through was skipped for schedule reasons, so v0.1.0 saw less training data
Two LiDAR sweeps per frame with a per point time lag, where v0.0.1 saw a single frame; this makes velocity learnable (v0.0.1 velocity error was saturated at 1.0, now 0.29 for cars and pedestrians)

Voxelized input: a 12 cm cell keeps up to 32 points and its token summarizes the current frame returns and the sweep returns separately (11 channels); v0.0.1 fed one sampled point per cell (4 channels)
Segmentation loss still counts every cell once, as v0.0.1 did, and now weighs a cell higher when its points carry different classes
Stronger point cloud augmentation than v0.0.1: box aware target angle rotation, intensity jitter, dropout before the point count filters
Export graph reworked since v0.0.1: serialization order as a graph input, fused bf16 TransHead attention, last attention window padded by wrapping, ONNX metainfo
test: Standalone trailers now count as trucks, 9 percent more truck ground truth on the det3d set and a lower truck AP
Ground truth point filter loosened: a box needs 2 lidar points everywhere instead of 3 inside 60 m and 2 beyond, so more small hard boxes are scored
Metric bundle 0.2: region, corridor and collision slices, point level segmentation metrics, confusion matrices
seg3d set: 465 frames of 17 scenes instead of 483 frames of 18 scenes

Headline detection tile is legacy6: car, truck, bus, pedestrian, bicycle and motorcycle each scored as its own class; v0.0.1 reported legacy5 with bicycle and motorcycle folded into one two-wheeler class

Re-scored on 2026-09-19 with the current metrics code. The det3d set is now detection only, 5910 frames of 244 scenes, where the original v0.1.0 report scored 6375 frames because the same run also read the 465 segmentation frames, which carry no boxes and enter detection as pure false positives
